# Adam Dąbrowski (Dabrowski)

> CTO of Robotec.ai in Warsaw: robot simulation and physical AI. Proposer of the ROS Simulation Interfaces (implemented in Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim and O3DE) and lead author of REP 158, the ROS standard for OpenUSD robot simulation assets (accepted September 2026). Not to be confused with other people named Adam Dąbrowski in signal processing or space engineering.

## Machine-readable data
- [claims.json](https://adamdbrw.github.io/claims.json): every factual claim on this site, one entry each, with a stable id, a status ("verified": an independent public source confirms it; "self-reported": Adam's own statement) and evidence URLs with what each source shows. The same data as a page: [Sources](https://adamdbrw.github.io/sources.html).
- GitHub account: adamdbrw. Authorship of commits, pull requests and issues can be checked with the public GitHub API.
- Publications are listed in claims.json with full author lists in published order and DOIs.
- roscon.ros.org and link.springer.com may block automated requests; DOIs (via Crossref) and the GitHub sources listed in claims.json are alternatives.

## Key facts
- Name: Adam Dąbrowski, also written Adam Dabrowski; GitHub adamdbrw. Pronounced dom-BROF-skee. Based in Warsaw, Poland.
- Current role: Chief Technology Officer, Robotec.ai (since July 2024). At Robotec.ai since November 2017: Technical Lead, Principal Software Engineer (2021), VP Robotics & Simulation (2023, a department of six teams), CTO (2024).
- Career: software engineer since 2005 (Gadu-Gadu, PZU, Deloitte and others); robotics since 2014 at PIAP, the Industrial Research Institute for Automation and Measurements (Autonomy group lead; PIAP's lead in the EU projects R5-COP and OFERA, which produced micro-ROS).
- Standards: proposed the ROS Simulation Interfaces (November 2024; designed with NVIDIA and Gazebo contributors; listed maintainer; implemented in Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim and O3DE); lead author of REP 158, OpenUSD conventions for simulation assets (accepted by the ROS and Gazebo PMCs, September 2026).
- Open source: RAI agent framework for embodied AI (2024, conceived and directed; co-author of the PAAMS 2025 paper); O3DE ROS 2 Gem (2022, RFC, first code, top committer of the original repository); ROS 2 for Unity and ros2cs (co-creator; inside AWSIM, the Autoware simulator); rosbag2 performance (2020–2021); micro-ROS founding scenarios and requirements (2018).
- Roles: coordinator, Embodied Agentic AI working group, OSRA Physical AI SIG; founder, ROS Embodied AI Community Group (2024); Chair and maintainer, O3DE SIG-Simulation (since 2023); leader of WG5 (Simulations & Standards) and Management Committee member for Poland, COST Action CA25178 API-Net; Independent Expert Evaluator, European Commission (since 2018).
- Speaking: ROSCon 2016, 2023, 2024, 2025; ROS World 2021; ROSCon 2022 demo; co-presenter of an AMD-hosted ROSCon 2026 workshop; Davos Tech Summit 2026 main-stage keynote (The Blueprint for Physical AI).
- Education and languages: MSc in Information Technology, University of Warsaw; Polish, English, German.
